source_note: 单调有界函数几乎处处连续
english_source_note: Monotone Bounded Functions Are Continuous Almost Everywhere
callout_id: 单调有界函数几乎处处连续#1
statement_en: Let $f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$ be a bounded monotone function. Then $f$ is continuous almost everywhere.
key_techniques: countability of discontinuities of monotone functions
callout_body: $f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$是单调有界函数，那么函数是几乎处处连续的函数。
